# Name the feed mode that an assertion actually checks

Proposed review fix for subtestCycleThroughFeedFormat: the assertion on webPageItem should say that the web page is selected. The historical patch checks that item but reports "Summary should be selected"; the retained accepted current test still has this mismatch after changing the assertion to hasAttribute. The assertion already contains should, so the issue is the wrong expected mode in its diagnostic message. Preserve the checked-state assertion and the ordered scenario. The available bug asks for feed-mode tests but does not discuss this message; the full patch review is still pending. This is a scoped diagnostic fix, not evidence that the mode behavior or test result failed. No test ran. Existing notes cover nested browser waits and popup-local state separately.

Scope: mail/base/test/browser.
